frequency_question: How often do Department of Education reviews of recognized accreditors result in a final formal termination order within a specified deadline?
membership_rule: Members are formal cyclical or special compliance reviews of federally recognized accrediting agencies by the US Department of Education involving contested institutional status; excluded are routine renewals without adverse enforcement steps.

cases.name: ABA initial compliance review under Margaret Spellings (2006-2008)
American Academics of Liberal Education (AALE) recognition loss
Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools (ACICS) first termination
ACICS reinstatement and second final termination
National Academy of Early Childhood Programs Accreditation / NAEYC review

coverage_note: 5 prominent contested national accreditor review cases named; estimated roughly 8 total major contested reviews in the modern era.
known_gaps: Minor specialized programmatic accreditors whose disputes are settled below the secretarial level are omitted.
skeleton: Total formal adverse review actions against major institutional/professional accreditors resulting in final termination orders divided by total major contested reviews over the modern regulatory era.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 5 named prominent contested review cases equals 60 percent.
validity_reason: Statutory frameworks for DOE recognition of accrediting agencies under the Higher Education Act remain stable across multi-year administrative cycles.
